coverage.sourceProjectionDefinition: Running text from the accepted twenty-one XML documents is preserved exactly, except reversible edge whitespace and inserted paragraph-boundary newlines. No running source words or punctuation are generated, removed or corrected. Source labels, annotations, explicitly delimited gap notices and front matter are excluded with reversible evidence. Ten accepted Latin identity registries govern XI–XX; split XI and XVI sections and XI's two separately identified Bellum interpolations preserve actual source order.
